document scan.desc:
Turn paper documents into clear PDFs with your iPhone. Scan a receipt, capture a contract or save your notes in a file that is easy to share.
SCAN EVERYDAY PAPERWORK
Capture documents, receipts, invoices and book pages. Use dedicated card and passport modes for personal documents, and scan multiple pages for longer files.
MAKE EVERY PAGE CLEARER
Automatic edge detection and cropping help frame your document. Straighten scans, reduce shadows, rotate pages and choose an enhanced, black-and-white, grayscale or original look.
ADD YOUR SIGNATURE
Draw and add a signature to a scanned document before sharing it.
EXPORT AND SHARE
Save scans as PDF or image files, send them by email and revisit saved scans in your document history.
